name: cold-email-salesblink
description: Run cold email sequences and sales outreach on autopilot via the SalesBlink API: lists, contacts, templates, sequences, senders, inbox, analytics, and deliverability tests.
long_description:
SalesBlink Cold Email gives your AI assistant access to the SalesBlink public REST API.

- **Campaigns**: build automated multi-step email sequences, launch, pause, resume, clone, and archive them
- **Leads**: create lists, import contacts in bulk (up to 500 per request), move and update leads
- **Templates**: reusable emails with merge variables like {{first_name}}, spintax, and attachments
- **Senders**: connect Gmail/Outlook via OAuth; SMTP/IMAP and bulk CSV uploads are handled through the SalesBlink web UI
- **Inbox**: read reply threads, reply to prospects, forward, mark read/unread, classify outcomes
- **Analytics**: track sent, opens, clicks, and replies with overall, daily, lead-level, and per-mailbox stats
- **Deliverability**: run inbox placement tests across Gmail, Outlook, and other providers
- **Workspace**: manage users, roles, workspaces, folders, domains, signatures, billing, and API keys

Sensitive actions such as creating or refreshing API keys, placing Done-For-You orders, adding mailboxes, and bulk-uploading sender credentials return magic login links that redirect the user to the SalesBlink web UI. The server ships the complete SalesBlink API reference docs as built-in tools, so the assistant can look up exact endpoints and payload shapes before making requests.

tools.name: salesblink_get
tools.description: Make a read-only GET request to the SalesBlink public API.

tools.name: salesblink_mutate
tools.description: Make a write request (POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE) to the SalesBlink public API.

tools.name: salesblink_signup
tools.description: Get the public SalesBlink sign-up link where a new user can create an account.

tools.name: salesblink_list_reference_docs
tools.description: List the bundled SalesBlink API reference doc topics.

tools.name: salesblink_get_reference_doc
tools.description: Read a bundled SalesBlink API reference doc with exact endpoints and payload shapes.

tools.name: salesblink_check_auth
tools.description: Verify the configured SalesBlink API key by calling GET /account/verify.

api_key.title: SalesBlink API Key
api_key.description: Your SalesBlink API key (starts with key-). Get one at https://run.salesblink.io/account/integration/api — or use the salesblink_signup tool to get the sign-up link.

log_level.title: Log Level
log_level.description: Server log verbosity: debug, info, warn, or error. Logs are written to stderr only.
